narrative: 完整的推轨会显得过头。仅仅几厘米的移动就足以证明房间是有纵深的：前景中的一支麦克风相对于一张脸滑动，一个瓶子相对于一扇窗转动。
这个运动的幅度是刻意保持小巧的。如果你需要的是一整个街区的规模，或者需要围绕一件产品做弧形运动，那么这就不是合适的工具。
如果轨道长达数米，那你做的其实是推轨。如果路径是一个圆圈，那你做的其实是环绕。
how: 固定一条短轨道，调平，选定一个恒定速度。保持运动是横向的，或者是一次微小的推进；不要在其中暗藏变焦。
提示词：短滑轨运镜，60到120厘米的横向移动，用于产品或访谈镜头的视差效果，精确而小巧。
when: 当完整的推轨显得过头、而固定镜头又需要一点视差时使用。具体场景：一个访谈单人镜头，前景中一盏台灯在6秒内滑动。
不要用滑轨来拍追逐戏。
vs: 推轨左移（Dolly Left）是同样的线性理念在房间或街道尺度上的运用。360°环绕（360-Degree Orbit）则是弧形且距离更长的运动。
推镜头（Push In）可以用滑轨作为轨道，但推镜头指的是Z轴方向上的念头；滑轨则特指这种短距线性工具。滑轨是紧凑的位移，而不是穿越建筑空间的路径。
examples_film: 这种语法更多体现在广告和访谈之中，而不是某个单一的著名场景：桌面产品广告、纪录片式的采访头像、剧情片中桌边的小幅移动。要学的是这60到120厘米的视差效果，而不是照搬某支具体的广告。
mistakes: 最常见的误用是完整的推轨左移，或者一个微缩的360°环绕。破绽在于移动距离达数米，或者出现了弧线。
解决办法：说明这是一条短轨道、直线路径、细微的视差，结束时仍处在同一个房间内。

faq.q: 电影中的滑轨镜头（Slider Shot）是什么？
faq.a: 它是摄影机在一条紧凑轨道上做的短距线性运动，通常在120厘米以内，用来给一个静止的画面增加细微的视差。

faq.q: 滑轨镜头（Slider Shot）与推轨左移（Dolly Left）的区别
faq.a: 推轨左移可以穿越一个房间或一条街道。滑轨则是它的紧凑版本：访谈、产品，一盏台灯相对于一张脸滑动。

faq.q: 什么时候该用滑轨镜头（Slider Shot）？
faq.a: 当固定镜头显得呆板、而完整的轨道又显得过头时使用。不要把它当作覆盖行走戏的替代方案。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写滑轨镜头（Slider Shot）的提示词？
faq.a: 写明：短滑轨，60到120厘米，横向移动，细微视差，持续6秒。禁止长距推轨，禁止圆形环绕。

narrative: A full dolly is too much. A few centimeters of travel can prove the room has depth: a microphone in the foreground slides against a face, a bottle turns against a window.
The move is small on purpose. It is the wrong tool for a city block, and the wrong tool if you needed a curve around a product.
If the rail is meters long, you are dollying. If the path is a circle, you are orbiting.
how: Clamp a short rail, level it, choose a constant speed. Keep the move lateral or a tiny push; do not hide a zoom inside it.
Prompt a short slider move, 60 to 120 centimeters of lateral travel, product or interview parallax, precise and small.
when: Use it when a full dolly is too much and a lock-off needs a little parallax. Concrete beat: an interview single with a lamp sliding in the foreground over 6 seconds.
vs: A Dolly Left is the same linear idea at room or street scale. An 360-Degree Orbit is curved and long.
A Push In may use a slider as the rail, but push in is the Z-axis thought; slider names the short linear tool. Slider is compact travel, not a path through architecture.
examples_film: The grammar is commercial and interview more than a single famous scene: tabletop product films, documentary talking heads, small table moves inside features. Use the 60-to-120-centimeter parallax, not a particular ad to clone.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a full Dolly Left or a tiny 360-Degree Orbit. The tell is meters of travel, or a curve.
The fix: name the short rail, linear path, subtle parallax, end still in the same room.

faq.q: What is Slider Shot in film?
faq.a: It is a short linear camera move on a compact rail, typically under about 120 centimeters, used to add small parallax to a still setup.
Dolly left can travel a room or a street. A slider is the compact rail version: interview, product, a lamp sliding against a face.

faq.q: When should I use Slider Shot?
faq.a: When a lock-off feels dead and a full track would be too much. Do not use it as a substitute for covering a walk.

faq.q: How do I prompt Slider Shot for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write short slider, 60 to 120 centimeters, lateral, subtle parallax, 6 seconds. Ban a long dolly and ban a circular orbit.
